_comment: CI data-audit gate configuration (scripts/data_audit.py). dataset_dir points at the dataset the repository currently ships, which is now v2 (built by src/dataset_builder_v2.py). It previously still pointed at the withdrawn v1 data in data/prompt_pairs/, so the gate reported 23 failures against a dataset the repository no longer ships and was never actually exercised against the released files -- while the paper claimed in two places that a 32-check gate runs in CI. All 32 dataset checks pass on v2. To reproduce the v1 defects for the record, point dataset_dir back at data/prompt_pairs and expect failure; that is the gate catching the audited defects.
_validation_dir_comment: Deliberately unset. The v1 manual-validation records were quarantined to data/validation/archive_v1_manual/ on 2026-08-25 (see the README there: their decision timing is not consistent with the human attribution they carry). The paper claims no human validation of paraphrase equivalence -- Section 3 states the opposite -- so there is no validation claim for this gate to verify. Restore this key only alongside records that pass annotation_timing.
